title: SII Vol. 19 No. 190 — Tiruvaduturai
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Gomuktisvara temple
summary: This records a sale of 2 ma and odd of land tax-free, for 15 kasu received by them by the sabha of Sattanur a brahmadeya in Tiraimur-nadu on the southern bank of the river, from Omasi Orriyuran Kuttan of Tiruvanikka a devadana and brahmadeya in Kiliyur-nadu, who endowed the same for the supply of 10

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 191 — Tiruvilakkudi
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Manavalesvara temple
summary: This records a tax-free sale of land situated along the river at Kuriyakkudi-mangalam by the sabha of Videlvidugu-chaturvedimangalam a brahmadeya in Nallarrur-nadu to the revenue authorities of the state (puravvuvari-tinaikkalattar) for 30 kasu (for being assigned to the temple)

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 192 — Tiruppundurutti
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine
summary: This records a gift of 15 kalanju of gold deposited with the sabha of Tirutturutti for burning a lamp out throughout the day in the temple by a resident of Nanandur in Arkkattuk-kurram

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 193 — Tiruchchatturai
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Odanavanesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 25 kalanju of gold for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahadeva at Tiruchchorrutturai by Mallan Arangan (a resident) of the Manjanattar-Velam at Tanjavur

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 194 — Vedaranyam
location_detail: On a pillar in the mandapa in front of the central shrine, Vedarayesvara temple
summary: It seems to record an endowment of tax-free land made to the temple of Tirumaraikkadadevar after purchase (from the assembly) by Naranan Kadan of Puliyarpattu the headman of Palaiyur, to provide for the supply of 7 and odd kalam of paddy for the celebration of a seven-day festival in the month of Ma

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 195
location_detail: On a pillar in the mandapa in front of the Ramanathesvara shrine, same temple
summary: This records a gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp with an ulakku of ghee a day in the temple of Mahadeva at Tirumariakkadu by oen Samanayaka-Perumal Tukki of Vettaivayal

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 195 — Tiruvellarai
location_detail: On the rock in front o the Jambunathasvami temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 196 — Tiruvellarai
location_detail: On the pillar in the rock-cut cave, Pundarikaksha-Perumal temple
date_text: This is dated in the 8th year of Parakesarivarman who may be identified with Uttama-chola (?)
summary: It registers a gift of 20 kalanju of gold made by Irayiravan Devi Ammanar the wife of the lord who died on elephant-back; i.e., prince Rajaditya, for providing for special offerings with 4 nali of rice on the days of the two vavu, sankranti and ashtami, to god Sri Krishna and goddess Sri-Rukmini in

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 197 — Tirumalpuram
location_detail: On the north, west and south walls of the central shrine in the ruined Vishnu temple
summary: This records an endowment of 70 kalanju of god by Tiruvikraman a merchant of Ulakkuni for the purpose of feeding ten Brahmanas daily in the temple of Perumandiagal at Govindapadi

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 198 — Kudumiyamalai
location_detail: On the north wall of the second prakara, Sikhanathasvami temple
summary: This is stated to be a copy of an older document incised at the instance of the headman of Kil-Taniyam in Ollaiyur-kurram

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 199 — Tiruppalatturai
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine, Adimulesvara temple
summary: This records that the Sivadharmis (priests) of the temple of Mahadeva-Bhatara at Truparrurai in Uttamasili-chaturvedimangalam on the southern bank of the river to burn a lamp in the temple with the interest on 8 kalanju of gold received by them from Aiyan Amudan a Vellala resident of Murukkur a haml

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 200
location_detail: On the same wall
date_text: This is dated in the 8th year of Parakesarivarman who has been surmised to be Uttma-chola
summary: This is an incomplete abstract of certain inscriptions recapitulating the endowments in land for worship, offerings and lamps in the temple, made by several persons in the 18th and 20th years of Parantaka I, which was ordered to be re-engraved out of their worn-out originals cut on the step of the o

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 201
summary: This is the same inscription as No. 173 of 1907 above

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 202 — Tiruvellarai
location_detail: On the rock in front of the Jambunathasvami temple
summary: This is the same as No. 528 of 1905 with the built in portion at the end cleared

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 203 — Koyil-tirumalam
location_detail: On a stone lying in the courtyard of the Magalesvara temple
summary: This inscription is mutilated and incomplete

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 204 — Kumbhakonam
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Nagesvarasvami temple
summary: This inscription has been assigned to Uttma-Chola on account of the details of date in the 8th year of the king which corresond to A.D. 979, January 30, Thursday

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 205
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: This records a gift of 96 sheep by order of a queen of Uttama-chola (name not given) for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Paramasvami of tirukkilkottam at Tirukkuddamukkil in Pambu-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 206 — Tiruvenkadu
location_detail: On the east inner Gopura, right of entrance, Svetaranyesvara temple
summary: It registers a gift of land at Kuttangudi, probably after purchasing it for 25 kalanju of gold, for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp in the Tiruvnkadudevar, by [Mina]van-Mahadeviyar a queen of Uttama-chola

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 207 — Koyil-Tevarayanpettai
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Matsyapurisvara temple
summary: This records the gift of a coco-nut garden, 3 ma in extent, to provide for one kasu per month for sidari fumigation during the 4 services in the day, and four kasu per year for the daily supply of sandal-paste, in the temple of Tiruchchelur Mahadeva at Rajakesari-chaturvedimangalam, by Pudi (Bhuti)

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 208
location_detail: On the south wall of the same shrine
summary: This records an endowment of half a veli and 4 ma of land for maintaining 5 musicians who were to play on instruments during the sribali service every day in the temple, by Karpaga-Aditan Asan Amudanakkan

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 209 — Sendalai
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Sundar3esvara temple
summary: This records and endowment of 15 kalanju of gold by one Omaindan Narayanan Anadtan of Kandiyur for buring with the interest on that amount a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tirupperundurai-Mahadeva at Chandralekhai-chaturvedimangalam a brahmadeya in Arkkattu-kurram

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 210
location_detail: On the west wall of the same shrine
summary: This inscription fixes the details of daily expenditure in paddy towards the ponagam offerings to the god, a dipamala of 161 amps to be burnt both morning and evening, a rice offering to god Brahma and a twilight lamp, in the temple of Tirupperundurai-mahadeva to be met out of the 30 kalam of paddy
